description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to configuring WPS settings for Wi-Fi networks, including enabling/disabling WPS, setting WPS methods, pairing clients, and canceling sessions. It performs user session validation, processes POST data, invokes setting functions, and outputs the received configuration.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum based on a 4 or 8 digit PIN, implementing checksum logic for WPS PIN validity.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies Wi-Fi settings to a specific SSID by modifying device configurations.
